{{Quote|There are three basic types in the galaxy: those of the Empire, those of the Rebellion, and everyone else. We of the Empire accomplish everything, the Rebels oppose everything, and the rest just get in the way.|Lieutenant Maximilian Vox, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TN" />}}
'''Maximilian Vox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You are a hero of the Empire and a shining beacon for all those who desire peace and harmony in the galaxy. It has been an honor for you to serve with me. I'm sure you agree.|Lieutenant Maximilian Vox, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BtdmtLMV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring the droid modules to Lt. Maximilian Vox|Naboo}}</ref>}}
Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Maximilian Vox was the immediate superior of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz]] and was based out of [[Kaadara]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he worked with a spacer who had previously worked with Commander Barrezz on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Vox tasked the operative with retrieving several droid modules dating back to the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The objective of Vox was to recreate a powerful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] technology that was lost over the years. In the meantime, the droid modules were also wanted by the operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Agent]] [[Wilson Tchorshel]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> The spacer found the positional awareness triangulator chip in a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] used by the [[Skaak Tippers]] in their [[Skaak Tipper Hideout|hideout]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTMD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Mouse Droid|Naboo}}</ref> The decentralized autonomy chip was given by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] after the spacer managed to compromise the security of [[Borvo's Vault]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: Borvo's Battle Droid" on Naboo</ref> The spacer recovered the strategy/tactics simulation chip after destroying a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] in the [[Stonewall Labs]] headquarters, thanks to the assistance of [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Zanier Hudmasse]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka" on Naboo</ref> Finally, the spacer retrieved the [[stochastic decision chip]] with the help of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] by destroying a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] in possession of the [[Ultragungans|Ultragungan Militia]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTGBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Old Republic Droid Modules: The Gungan Battle Droid" on Naboo</ref> The operative was successful and was then awarded the [[Medal of the Emperor's Fist/Legends|Medal of the Emperor's Fist]] by Maximilian Vox. With the four modules reunited, Vox quickly left Naboo in order to transfer the AI modules to Imperial scientists and droid engineers.<ref name="SWG:BtdmtLMV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maximilian Vox appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts,<ref name="SWG:TN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Maximilian Vox was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
